Non-opted production path and invalid source/device/surface identity remain original D3D9 fallback; native tile is not a full frame or OpenXR stereo.
Source-matched RAW and DX9Ex control launchers, negative package regressions and mandatory five GitHub workflow gates succeed at one original source SHA.
